prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Identify the accident and the accident code.
3. Make a note in the margin of which accident report this corresponds to (if anything).
4. Is there an occupational injury on any body part? Y/N.
5. If yes, go to Work Code 101 and start filling out the report.
6. Not the VO! Not the NI!
7. Don’t forget that the serious and very serious accidents require reporting as well.
8. Don’t forget to delete the records of all accidents, including those in the fatal and especially serious group.

An important point: investigate any accidents in the fatal and especially serious groups.
